session_evidence: Company release: call 2026-09-03 5:00 p.m. ET, 'will report its financial results in a press release prior to the conference call' - i.e. after the 4:00 p.m. close. https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/20/3348348/0/en/concrete-pumping-holdings-sets-third-quarter-2026-earnings-conference-call-for-thursday-september-3-2026.html
where_to_look: Concrete pumping volume is a direct read on non-residential and infrastructure pours. Dodge Momentum Index and the AIA/Deloitte Architecture Billings Index readings for March-June 2026 lead BBCP's May-July revenue by roughly one to two quarters and are free

Regional concentration: BBCP's US business is weighted to specific metros and its UK business (Camfaud) is a separate cycle. Look for a divergence between the US and UK segments that a single-estimate consensus cannot carry

Data-centre and industrial mega-project pours - the one part of non-res that is booming. Whether BBCP has captured any of it is a specific, answerable question from its fleet-utilisation and pricing commentary
Leverage and the fleet capex/free-cash-flow line: this is a leveraged roll-up, so the debt paydown and covenant headroom disclosure moves the equity more than the EBITDA beat
1 estimate, no options chain - the market's expectation is genuinely unobservable here, which cuts both ways for a hunter
